verdict.rationale: LocalAI's getting-started docs show a GGUF file being run directly with `local-ai run huggingface://TheBloke/phi-2-GGUF/phi-2.Q8_0.gguf`. Its functions docs also state that tool-call formats are auto-detected "for any ggml/gguf model", which confirms GGUF is a natively supported model format. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of GGUF loading options (local file paths, model config, quantization-level handling), backend details for GGUF, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format

citations.quote: the autoparser detects the tool call format for any ggml/gguf model that was trained with tool support
